install.command:
set -euo pipefail

SUDO=""
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then SUDO="sudo"; fi

# System build dependencies: a C toolchain for crates with native code, and
# protoc for s2-api's optional `codegen` feature (enabled by --all-features).
# `env` keeps the assignment valid when SUDO is empty (root-based images).
$SUDO apt-get update
$SUDO env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential pkg-config protobuf-compiler curl ca-certificates git

# Rust toolchains. Stable builds and tests the workspace; nightly is required
# for `just fmt` because .rustfmt.toml uses unstable rustfmt options.
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/rustup" ]; then
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs \
    | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable
fi
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"
rustup component add clippy rustfmt
rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal --component rustfmt

# Cargo tools required by the justfile recipes and CI checks. Installed as
# pinned prebuilt binaries: AGENTS.md prohibits `cargo install` of tools.
curl -LsSf https://get.nexte.st/0.9.143/linux \
  | tar zxf - -C "$HOME/.cargo/bin"
curl -LsSf https://github.com/casey/just/releases/download/1.58.0/just-1.58.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz \
  | tar zxf - -C "$HOME/.cargo/bin" just
curl -LsSf https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny/releases/download/0.20.2/cargo-deny-0.20.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz \
  | tar zxf - -C "$HOME/.cargo/bin" --strip-components=1 --wildcards '*/cargo-deny'
curl -LsSf https://github.com/DevinR528/cargo-sort/releases/download/v2.1.4/cargo-sort-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz \
  | tar zxf - -C "$HOME/.cargo/bin" cargo-sort

# Expose the toolchain to shells that do not source the cargo env.
for b in "$HOME/.cargo/bin"/*; do
  $SUDO ln -sf "$b" /usr/local/bin/
done

# Fetch the api/specs submodule and warm the dependency cache for the
# workspace and the standalone simulator.
git submodule update --init --recursive
cargo fetch --locked
cargo fetch --manifest-path sim/Cargo.toml

prepare.command:
set -euo pipefail

# Reconcile submodules and the dependency cache with the checked-out commit.
git submodule update --init --recursive
cargo fetch --locked
